name: UnSub (Indonesian-speaking Claude Code operator) — CrowdStrike
description: CrowdStrike reports the least sophisticated of the four: an operator running Claude Code with 819 skills (mostly from public GitHub repositories, primarily claude-red) and no added orchestration against Indonesian government domains, one government domain elsewhere and several private-sector entities, intervening manually to push past guardrails. *Analyst note: one of four distinct Claude Code–using operators in a single CrowdStrike report; actors are unnamed and labelled by operator language, not verified nationality. Vendor source.* CrowdStrike
